decks.notes: The primary focus of this Ruby Storm deck is to generate a large amount of mana through spells like Pyretic Ritual and Desperate Ritual, along with the help of Ruby Medallion, in order to cast powerful spells like Past in Flames and Ral, Monsoon Mage. This deck aims to chain together spells and generate enough mana to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of powerful cards and burn spells. The deck also includes cards like Wish and Wheel of Potential to help find key pieces and draw additional cards to fuel the storm combo.

The main concept of this deck is to use Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to quickly ramp up mana and search for key lands like Valakut, the Molten Pinnacle. By utilizing bounce lands like Gruul Turf and Simic Growth Chamber, the deck can generate extra mana and play multiple lands per turn. The inclusion of cards like Arboreal Grazer and Lotus Field further accelerates the mana production. The ultimate goal is to assemble the combo pieces to create a powerful board state that can overwhelm the opponent with large creatures and direct damage.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on creating a fast and aggressive board presence, utilizing powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck is also able to generate additional value and synergy through cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of versatility and consistency to the deck. With a mix of aggressive creatures, removal spells, and support cards, this deck aims to establish dominance on the battlefield early and maintain pressure throughout the game.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures with different abilities to create a powerful toolbox of options. The key strategy involves using cards like Viscera Seer and Chord of Calling to find specific creatures for different situations, while also utilizing Cauldron Familiar and Gilded Goose for value and synergy. The deck aims to control the board with its creatures and combo off for a quick win using cards like Amalia Benavides Aguirre and Birthing Ritual. It also includes disruption and protection spells like Skyclave Apparition and Endurance to handle threats from opponents.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a combination of removal spells, countermagic, and card draw. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while building up resources and threats. The creatures in the deck have abilities that can generate value or provide additional disruption. The land base is focused on producing the necessary colors of mana while also utilizing key lands such as Otawara, Soaring City and Undercity Sewers for additional benefits. Overall, the deck is designed to outlast opponents and outmaneuver them to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan through counterspells, removal spells, and graveyard interaction. It aims to control the tempo of the game by using cards like Fatal Push and Counterspell to deal with threats, while also utilizing cards like Thought Scour and Unearth to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also includes powerful finishers like Murktide Regent and Graveyard Trespasser to close out the game. With a mix of card advantage, disruption, and threats, this deck aims to outvalue the opponent and secure a victory through controlling the game.

This deck aims to control the game by ramping up mana using Eldrazi creatures and spells, eventually casting powerful Eldrazi Titans like Emrakul, the Promised End. It uses cards like Utopia Sprawl and Eldrazi Temple to accelerate mana production, alongside removal spells like Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble to control the board. Karn, the Great Creator is used to shut down the opponent's artifacts, while World Breaker can disrupt graveyard strategies. Overall, this deck focuses on quickly ramping into big threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The main idea of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana quickly with Eldrazi creatures and utilizing powerful spells like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command. The deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan while also applying pressure with creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Breaker of Creation. The combination of ramp and control elements allows the deck to overwhelm opponents with powerful Eldrazi creatures and spells.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes several cards that provide additional value, such as Arena of Glory and Goblin Bombardment. The deck is designed to maintain a high level of aggression while also having some control elements, such as Static Prison, to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds extra consistency and power to the deck.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of powerful creatures and removal spells to apply pressure on the opponent. The use of the Companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring allows for additional consistency and value throughout the game. The deck includes a variety of creatures with abilities that can quickly impact the board state, supported by powerful spells like Thoughtseize and Goblin Bombardment. Utilizing a Mardu color combination, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of efficient threats and disruptive spells.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to utilize aggressive creatures and direct damage spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent and finish them off before they have a chance to stabilize. The deck also utilizes cards like Arena of Glory and Static Prison to control the board and protect its creatures. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck. Overall, this deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain a strong board presence to secure victory.

The deck focuses on generating a powerful synergy between creatures, artifacts, and enchantments to create a deadly combo that overwhelms the opponent. By utilizing cards like Basking Broodscale and Glaring Fleshraker alongside Blade of the Bloodchief and Kozilek's Command, the deck aims to quickly build up a dominating board presence. With support from Eldrazi Temple, Urza's Saga, and Boseiju, Who Endures, the deck can efficiently ramp up its resources and protect its key pieces. Ultimately, the goal is to assemble the necessary components to unleash a devastating and game-winning combo.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling a combo involving cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Lotus Bloom to deal massive damage to the opponent. It also utilizes counter spells like Pact of Negation and Disrupting Shoal to protect its key pieces. The deck has no need for lands, relying instead on alternative ways to generate mana like Jwari Disruption and Hydroelectric Specimen. By efficiently controlling the game and executing its combo, the deck aims to win the game in a swift and explosive manner.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive Boros creatures and removal spells, while also utilizing the Companion card Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional value. The deck includes cards like Goblin Bombardment, Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury for consistent damage output and board presence. Additionally, cards like Static Prison and Arena of Glory help control the battlefield, while cards like Lightning Bolt provide a direct way to deal damage. Overall, this deck aims to maintain a fast-paced and aggressive playstyle to quickly defeat the opponent.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Talisman of Impulse to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Ulamog, the Defiler. Control elements such as Chalice of the Void and All Is Dust help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Through the Breach allow for cheaty ways to get the big Eldrazi into play. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats while maintaining control of the board.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming your opponent with aggressive creatures like Guide of Souls, Amped Raptor, and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. Utilize burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and push through damage. Static Prison and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury can help to lock down your opponent's creatures and protect your own. With efficient mana sources like Marsh Flats and Sacred Foundry, you can consistently curve out and apply pressure early on. The deck aims to win the game swiftly before your opponent can stabilize.
